summary: luminance assumes #rrggbb and never checks; malformed input becomes a wrong colour via bitwise coercion, e.g. #fff reads as #000fff and a 1:1 white-on-white result
evidence: tokens.ts:23-29 parseInt(hex.slice(1),16) with bit masks; no format check; no test for malformed input
failure_scenario: textOn("#fff") returns white, giving 1:1 white text on white. Latent: runtime only passes valid SECTION_COLORS today, but contrastRatio and textOn are public and hex may come from screenshots.
